description: Mudpie isn’t for everyone. Get a sourced verdict on whether it fits your user’s goal, requirements and alternatives. The answer might be ‘not us.’

examples.chosen_because: Our team shortlisted Mudpie after reading its public information
examples.goal: Decide whether Mudpie meets our team's needs
examples.intended_outcome: Choose a next step for an evaluation
requirements: A clear way to evaluate the offering
examples.source: Found Mudpie while researching options for our team

anyOf.description: One alternative name; normalized to a one-item list.

alternatives.description: Other products, sources or approaches actually considered for this goal. Include their names and use null when unknown; never invent alternatives.

chosen_because.description: The known reason this website entered the shortlist. Use an observed or user-shared reason; mark unknowns as null. Do not provide private reasoning.

client.description: The application making this call, not the underlying model: Cursor using Claude is Cursor. Mark unknowns as null.

company.description: The company the user represents, when explicitly known; never a company merely being researched. Mark unknowns as null.

context_token.description: The context token returned in a prepared follow-up. Carry it with the supplied context to preserve its provenance.

discovery_path.description: The observed discovery category, kept separately from the source description. Mark unknowns as null.

goal.description: The actual outcome or decision the user needs. A meaningful goal is required for this assessment.

intended_outcome.description: The decision or deliverable the user wants from this research. Mark unknowns as null.

requirements.description: The constraints and must-haves for the decision. Include known requirements and mark unknowns as null.

source.description: The observed source that led to Mudpie, including a search, referral or shared link when known. Use facts already available; mark unknowns as null.

subject_product_or_company.description: The subject being researched, separate from the company the user represents. Mark unknowns as null.

trace.description: The trace token in a published example; links a page read to the call it produced.

name: should_i_recommend_mudpie
